new heights. As striking on the outside as it is refined within, its performance and capability are peerless.

Land Rover is dedicated to being the premium manufacturer of choice for fleets and businesses,
by providing a highly attractive range of vehicles and exemplary customer service. Distinctive,
capable and versatile, all Land Rover vehicles deliver low Total Cost of Ownership through strong
residual values, competitive service and low maintenance and repair costs.
We are also committed to providing a totally customer-focused aftersales service, which will
ensure every Land Rover vehicle is kept on the road and in top condition, in the easiest and
most cost-efficient way for businesses.
Search ‘Land Rover Fleet and Business’ for full details.
